card.title: How to repair iPhone 12 pro to 14 pro max rear camera portrait mode not working

source.title: How to repair iPhone 12 pro to 14 pro max rear camera portrait mode not working

claims.statement: On iPhone 12 Pro–14 Pro Max, LiDAR fails after drops, liquid, or when a tech doesn't transfer the paired LiDAR during a rear housing swap; portrait mode and Measure then fail.
Fix: JC Repair Assistant 'Brushing' unbind with an IPSW flash (backs up LiDAR data to the cloud), then program a JCID programmable LiDAR sensor and install it.

procedure: Confirm Measure and portrait mode fail; ask about rear housing swaps.
Run Brushing unbind and flash in JC Repair Assistant (re-flash in 3uTools if stuck).
Program JCID LiDAR sensor; install and test.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: The unbind flash process erases the device.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
